decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SL1100, BL03, BL04,XX02, EL01, AD3100, Design and Access Statement prepared by Acanthus Architect LW (dated 28th January 2016), Heritage Justification prepared by Acanthus Architects LW (dated 2nd February 2016 Rev0), Flood Risk Assessment matrix (unnumbered, no date). Received on 19 February 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Conversion of part of the garage into offices including replacing roller shutter with a matching window
